caption: The drawing depicts a tall grandfather clock positioned slightly to the right of center, rendered in shades of brown, gold, and tan to imitate wood grain and decorative inlay. The clock has a rectangular lower base with curved feet and a circular pattern with green detailing. The central trunk section is tall and rectangular, featuring two vertically stacked oval designs with green accents. The clock's upper section, or hood, has a classical arch with scrollwork at the top and a finial at the center. The clock face is white with black Roman numerals, gold detailing, and two black hands, surrounded by a decorative frame. Above the clock face, there is a semi-circular inset with a painted face of the moon in a blue sky. On the left side of the image, there is a faint, partial architectural line drawing done in pencil, showing a section or elevation of a structure, possibly related to furniture or interior design, with faint indications of molding and a small oval motif. The background is an off-white or light beige tone.
title: Grandfather's Clock
